claims: Amy Madigan won the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress at the 2026 Oscars for her role as Aunt Gladys in Weapons.
Amy Madigan set a new record for the longest gap between a first nomination and first victory at 40 years.
Elle Fanning was a 2026 Supporting Actress nominee for Sentimental Value.
Inga Ibsdotter Lilleaas was a 2026 Supporting Actress nominee for Sentimental Value.
Wunmi Mosaku was a 2026 Supporting Actress nominee for Sinners.
Teyana Taylor was a 2026 Supporting Actress nominee for One Battle After Another.
Amy Madigan's victory was her first Academy Award.
Amy Madigan received a previous nomination for Twice in a Life in 1986.
